set.body: Prove that codec extensibility is real rather than nominal. Add a test-only bytes-to-bytes codec with metadata schema plus synchronous JVM and asynchronous Scala.js executors entirely outside the built-in codec implementation. Open, read, create where supported, and round-trip direct and sharded fixtures through the supplied registry without changing parser, planner, reader, writer, or domain modules. Gate: positive cross-platform round trips and precise failures when schema or executor capability is absent; no production dependency or fake interoperability claim.
set.title: Zarr Z6.3: prove an external codec provider on both platforms
